subject: Startups
title: Mint's Blog-First Launch
description: A fast breakdown of Mint's Blog-First Launch for builders.

hook.text: Mint launched a personal finance blog before it launched the product. By day one, it had 20K waiting users.

buildup.text: The blog covered budgeting tips, savings hacks, and financial planning. It ranked #1 on Google for key finance terms.

discovery.text: When Mint finally launched, the blog audience converted instantly. They already trusted the brand and wanted the tool.

twist.text: Competitor Wesabe had a better product but launched with zero audience. Mint's content head start was decisive.

climax.text: Mint reached 1.5 million users in two years. Intuit acquired it for $170 million in 2009.

punchline.text: Build the audience before you build the product.

quiz.question: What strategy did Mint use before launching its product?
options: Building a popular finance blog first
